name: Katapic – AI Product Descriptions & SEO for WooCommerce
author: Leomat

sections.description:
Katapic turns your WooCommerce catalog into clearer, better-structured product pages — easier to find on Google and in AI search engines (also called answer engines) like ChatGPT and Perplexity. In other words: SEO and AEO (Answer Engine Optimization) for your product catalog, without the manual work.

This plugin connects your store to Katapic in one click. You don’t have to create or copy any API keys: the plugin sets up the connection for you, securely, and your products are imported automatically.

With your store connected, in Katapic you can:

  • See a clear search‑visibility score for every product, on two axes: SEO (Google) and AI search / AEO (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews).
  • Rewrite weak product descriptions in bulk with AI — review the before/after, then publish back to your store.
  • Fill the gaps that make products hard to find: thin descriptions, missing attributes, weak titles.
  • Keep your catalog optimized as it grows, in 10 languages.

What this plugin does on your store: it creates a WooCommerce REST API key (read/write) so Katapic can read your products and write back optimized descriptions. It never touches your customers, orders or payments.

New in 1.1.0 — AI Search (AEO) tools that run locally on your site (no external calls, each one can be switched off):

  • /llms.txt — publishes a plain-text summary of your catalog (categories and products) that AI crawlers can read.
  • Product schema enrichment — fills missing brand, GTIN and material in the structured data WooCommerce already outputs. It never duplicates or overrides existing values.
  • FAQ structured data — adds FAQPage markup only when a product description really contains questions and answers.

These tools help AI assistants read your store’s real data. They do not — and cannot — guarantee that your products appear or rank in any AI answer.

A Katapic account is required (you can create one for free during the connection). Katapic is a third‑party service — see the External services section below.

External services

This plugin connects your site to Katapic, a third‑party SaaS hosted at app.katapic.com, to optimize your product listings.

  • When data is sent: when you click Connect to Katapic, and afterwards while your store stays connected.
  • What is sent on connect: your site address (URL), your store name, and a WooCommerce REST API key that the plugin generates on your store. The login/registration to Katapic happens on app.katapic.com — your Katapic password is never seen by the plugin.
  • What Katapic does with it: uses the API key to read your products and write back optimized descriptions. It does not read or store your customers, orders or payment data.
  • Terms of Service: https://app.katapic.com/legal?type=terms
  • Privacy Policy: https://app.katapic.com/legal?type=privacy

You can disconnect at any time from this plugin’s page (which revokes the API key), or from WooCommerce → Settings → Advanced → REST API.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin (WooCommerce must be active).
  2. Go to WooCommerce → Katapic.
  3. Click Connect to Katapic, log in or create your free account, and approve.
  4. Done — your products are imported and ready to optimize.
sections.faq:
Do I need to create API keys myself?

No. The plugin creates the WooCommerce API key for you and sets up the connection. (If you prefer, you can still connect manually inside Katapic.)

Will this make my products show up in ChatGPT or Google?

Katapic structures and completes your product pages so they are easier for Google and AI search engines to understand. It improves how machine‑readable and complete your listings are — it does not guarantee rankings or citations, which always depend on each search or AI engine.

What is AEO / AI search optimization?

AEO (Answer Engine Optimization) means making your products clear and structured enough that AI answer engines like ChatGPT and Perplexity can find and recommend them. Katapic scores and improves your catalog for this, alongside classic Google SEO.

Does it work with my theme or page builder?

Yes. Katapic optimizes the WooCommerce product data (titles, descriptions, attributes), so it works regardless of your theme or page builder.

Is it free?

The plugin is free. Katapic offers a free plan; paid plans unlock more AI usage.

What data does Katapic access?

Only your products. The connection is scoped so Katapic reads your catalog and writes back optimized descriptions. It does not access customers, orders or payments.

How do I disconnect?

Open WooCommerce → Katapic and click Disconnect — this revokes the API key on your store.
sections.changelog:
1.1.0

  • New: AI Search (AEO) tools, all local to your site and individually switchable — /llms.txt catalog summary for AI crawlers; enrichment of the existing WooCommerce product structured data (fills missing brand, GTIN, material — never duplicates); FAQPage markup generated only from Q&A really present in the product description.
  • No new data is sent to Katapic or anywhere else by these features.

1.0.2

  • Clearer plugin name and description so merchants searching for SEO / AI product descriptions can find it. Added details on SEO + AI search (AEO) and new FAQs. No change to functionality.

1.0.1

  • Clearer, more accurate wording in the plugin description and admin screen — no change to functionality.

1.0.0

  • Initial release: one‑click connection to Katapic with automatic product import.
